official.title: TU Delft MXR Lab is recruiting at PhD and postdoc level simultaneously (4 concurrent openings)
official.excerpt: Verified from four concurrent official postings (July 2026): PhD XR for Inclusive AV Interaction (req 1366984057, deadline 2026-08-30); PhD XR for Safe & Active Mobility / SAFE MOVE (req 1363878257, deadline 2026-07-19); Postdoc XR Inclusive AV Interaction (req 1366984557, deadline 2026-08-30); PhD Data & AI Micromobility Safety / SAFE MOVE (req 1363882157, deadline 2026-07-19). All in the Mobility in eXtended Reality Lab, Dept. of Transport & Planning, CEG.

ai.implications: A dedicated XR-behaviour lab at a priority-1 institution is hiring at PhD AND postdoc level simultaneously (4 concurrent openings) - funded, growing, and methodologically aligned (XR development + human-participant experiments + real-world transfer), not generic XR activity.
ai.recruitment_rationale: The lab is CURRENTLY recruiting (direct evidence, not inference): two XR PhDs, one XR postdoc and one data/AI PhD in one cycle, all under the Mobility in eXtended Reality Lab. Methodological alignment with the target identity is exact (Unity/XR development, experimental design, user studies, XR-to-real-world transfer).
risks: Current openings may absorb this funding wave - the next doctoral opening could be years away if these fill
Alignment judgment is based on four postings; the lab's broader agenda may weight data/AI more than XR-behaviour

manual.notes: TAG: lab-expansion / future-recruitment-monitoring. A funded, growing XR-behaviour lab at a priority-1 target. One contact (Dr. Yan Feng) covers both XR PhD openings.
